## Hypothesis

The sniper_stage2_grinder refined top-5 keepers from stage1, seeking to improve edge capture on J's anchor days while maintaining wide P&L. The top keeper shows high win rate (93.2%) and wide P&L ($40,656.65) but fails to capture the 5/01 J winner (0 P&L) and instead profits on loser days. This suggests the strategy may be overfit to non-J days or specific J day patterns (4/29 and 5/04), lacking robustness across all anchor days.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers on SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK with:  
- Volume ≥ 1.1× 20-bar average volume (`vol_mult=1.1`)  
- Minimum candle body size ≥ 2 cents (`body_min_cents=0.02`)  
- Requires ≥ 2 confirming signals (`min_stars=2`)  
- Trades ITM-2 puts (`strike_offset=2`)  
- Requires break above open (`require_break_above_open=true`)  
- Proximity to level ≤ $1.50 (`proximity_dollars=1.5`)  
Exit uses:  
- 6% premium stop (`premium_stop_pct=-0.06`)  
- 40% TP1 on 2/3 position (`tp1_premium_pct=0.4`, `tp1_qty_fraction=0.667`)  
- Runner target 300% (`runner_target_pct=3.0`)  
- Profit lock armed immediately (`profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.0`) with 8% stop offset (`profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.08`)  
- Fixed qty=10 contracts

2. **Sample bias:** Sample size = 6 J anchor days (3 winners, 3 losers). Selection method: optimized on 234-trade wide sample (non-J days dominant), evaluated on 6 anchor days. Overfit risk: high — edge_capture (373.48) < OP-16 floor (771) and missed 5/01 winner entirely.
